headline: Argentina Enters Technical Recession as Q3 GDP Shrinks
summary: Argentina's economic activity activity rose 1.1% in September but fell 1.2% year-on-year, confirming two consecutive quarters of contraction and a technical recession.
why: Argentina is South America's third-largest economy, and macroeconomic contraction impacts sovereign debt valuations and corporate earnings across the region.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Two straight quarters of economic contraction signal reduced output and consumer demand.
